name: CarryCraft Bags & Accessories
description: D2C maker of laptop bags, sleeves, and tech-carry accessories designed to protect gadgets in transit for commuters, students, and travellers.

products.name: CarryCraft Metro 15 Padded Laptop Backpack
products.description: A commuter backpack with a dedicated, heavily padded 15-inch to 15.6-inch laptop compartment, water-resistant fabric, and a USB charging pass-through. Sized precisely to protect a standard 15-inch business laptop during daily travel.

products.name: CarryCraft Slim 13 Laptop Sleeve
products.description: A minimalist felt-and-leather sleeve tailored for 13-inch to 13.3-inch ultrabooks. Ultra-slim, lightweight, and easy to slot into another bag — perfect for a thin, light 13-inch ultrabook.

products.name: CarryCraft Fortress 16 Gaming & Travel Backpack
products.description: A large, rugged backpack with reinforced protection and a spacious 16-inch to 17-inch laptop bay plus room for a bulky charger and peripherals. Built to haul a heavy high-performance gaming laptop safely.

products.name: CarryCraft Tech Organizer Pouch
products.description: A padded organizer pouch with elastic loops and mesh pockets for a wireless mouse, small keyboard, chargers, and other loose accessories. Keeps everyday gadgets tidy and protected inside any bag.

products.name: CarryCraft Hard-Shell Headphone Case
products.description: A rigid, crush-resistant hard-shell case shaped to hold over-ear headphones with a mesh pocket for the cable and adapter. Protects premium noise-cancelling headphones from damage while travelling.

products.name: CarryCraft Cable Management Roll
products.description: A roll-up organizer with straps and pockets that tames USB-C hubs, adapters, and tangled cables into one tidy bundle. Ideal for anyone carrying a docking hub and multiple cables.

products.name: CarryCraft Crossbody Tech Sling
products.description: A compact crossbody sling with padded pockets for a portable SSD, power bank, phone, and small gadgets. Great for carrying valuable pocket-sized electronics securely on short trips.

products.name: CarryCraft Heritage Leather Laptop Messenger
products.description: A full-grain leather messenger bag with a padded 14-inch to 16-inch laptop section and a professional look for client meetings. A premium carry option for business laptops.

products.name: CarryCraft Voyager Rolling Laptop Trolley
products.description: A wheeled trolley bag with a protected laptop compartment and expandable storage for frequent flyers hauling a laptop plus a monitor or gear between offices.

products.name: CarryCraft Minimalist Device Folio
products.description: A slim folio that holds a tablet or thin laptop plus a webcam, cables, and cards in one flat carry piece. A lightweight everyday option for hybrid workers with minimal gear.
